title: Prompts to Proxies: Emulating Human Preferences via a Compact LLM Ensemble

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the alignment system's performance on the World Values Survey across different locales (US, Great Britain, Hong Kong) and analyzing how prediction errors scale with 'cultural divergence' to reveal a bias toward US/Western ground truth.

Comparing aggregate LLM ensemble survey responses against human ground truth data (American Trends Panel) using distribution metrics (MSE, 1-JSD, EMD) and response entropy to evaluate the model's ability to reflect heterogeneous population preferences rather than collapsing to central tendencies.
